what: The crypto scorecard: what the review day reads, written before the days are counted. It sits beside the 60-day evidence window (pinned, unchanged); it does not replace it.

decided.words: Keep your best reasoning in place and take decisions for every part and continue here. Crypto is a very straightforward market. Only buys or keep off until cooling.
decided.also: It has to keep an eye for potential pullbacks and other market swings, any potential chances
decided.how: Decided by Claude on Madhav's delegation, from the plan review of 10 Nov (5.5 of 10: 'the window counts days, not clean days').

review_day: the later of 14 Dec 2026 and the 30th clean night in a row
clean_night: A night counts when all three hold: the $500 book stepped on that night's daily candle; the officer's note read the dial from the same candle; the book check found nothing (trades, holdings, cash and value agree). One night that fails starts the count again.

the_book.rule: Bitcoin 40% and Ethereum 20% of the book when the dial is open, all cash when it is closed (the all-in core, the rule tested on 2018-2026). Small trades only by a rule that is ACTIVE with a passing cell. Three safety stops.
the_book.frozen: No rule of the book changes between the freeze and the review day, except to repair a fault, said in the change book.

lines.line: The live book against the same rule replayed on the same candles
lines.pass: within 1% of the book's value over the clean nights
lines.note: read once, on the review day

lines.line: The book against holding the same coins (60% Bitcoin and Ethereum, 40% cash, never sold)
lines.pass: a smaller worst fall; the return is reported, not marked

lines.line: Every buy and sell inside the NDAX bid and ask of its minute

lines.pass: each firing said in that night's note

lines.line: The officer's note against the book, night by night
lines.pass: no wrong figure on a clean night

lines.line: The short-dip rule's paper record on big coins (recording only)
lines.pass: no mark: counted and reported; ten closed trades are needed before any decision

lines.line: Big moves in the ten main coins: caught, seen, missed
lines.pass: no mark: reported, with those held back on purpose while buying was off
each one listed with its night and its repair

left_running_until_review: The Explorer's paper trades, the small-coin (tier C) measuring books and the random baselines keep recording: they never touch the account, and they are how Ananta keeps an eye on pullbacks and swings. The brain stays asleep as a buyer. Each is kept, shrunk or stopped on the review day, on its own record.
